##: The live manifest. Seeded by hand from packaging/scoop/tapir.json in the tapir
repository (docs/release.md, «Засівання bucket»); bumped after that by this bucket's
own Excavator, which reads the checkver and autoupdate fields below.
The '#/tapir.exe' fragment renames the download, so 'bin' and 'shortcuts' stay stable
across versions while the release asset keeps its version in its name.
'persist' carries both folders Tapir keeps beside the exe: 'data' (settings, profiles)
and 'recordings' (what the app exists for). Under scoop they would otherwise live in
the versioned app directory that 'scoop cleanup' and 'scoop uninstall' delete.
autoupdate's hash comes from the release's .sha256 sidecar: '$url' is the download URL
with the '#/' fragment stripped, and the sidecar's '<hex64> *<filename>' line is what
description: Accessible Internet Radio Recorder for Windows
